Belgium seek marquee statement win in Rome.
Portugal have already clinched their quarterfinal spot in Group A4.

keyPlayers.name: Kevin De Bruyne

headToHead: Italy beat Belgium in Euro 2020 quarterfinals and 2021 Nations League finals.
roundLabel: UEFA Nations League · Group A2 Matchday 3
resultSummary: UPCOMING: Italy vs Belgium · Group A2 Matchday 3 in Rome
headline: Nations League MD3: Italy host Belgium in heavyweight Rome showdown
whyCareReason: Spalletti's rejuvenated Azzurri can virtually seal a top-two quarterfinal seed with victory over Belgium at Stadio Olimpico.
teaser: Thursday 8 October, Stadio Olimpico. Heavyweight clash headlines 10-match Nations League slate.
story: UEFA Nations League Matchday 3 takes center stage Thursday night headlined by Group A2 leaders Italy welcoming Belgium to Rome's Stadio Olimpico. Luciano Spalletti's squad stormed into first place with September victories against France and Israel, showcasing high pressing and quick transitions. Domenico Tedesco's Red Devils need points to stay in quarterfinal contention. With Portugal already through to the last eight after four straight wins, Italy can take a giant step toward joining them.
stakes: Top spot in Nations League Group A2 and seeding for the 2026 quarterfinals.
rivalryAngle: Two European heavyweights renew continental rivalry in Rome.
